If placed side-by-side, the Sun would appear microscopic compared to such giants. The Planner incorrectly dismissed option B by assuming a comparison only to "main-sequence" stars (limiting the radius to ~10x the Sun) and ignoring evolved supergiants and hypergiants which are significantly larger. Consequently, the Planner selected the wrong option (A) and prematurely concluded the task was complete with an incorrect solution.
